nodes.name: Get Today's Events
nodes.notes: Google Calendar OAuth2 credential is attached by the user in the n8n editor and lives ONLY in n8n's credential store (ADR-0004) — it is never part of this export. alwaysOutputData keeps the workflow running on a zero-event day (one empty item) so the formatter can answer pleasantly. $now uses the instance timezone (GENERIC_TIMEZONE), so 'today' is the user's today.

nodes.name: Summarize with Ollama
nodes.notes: Local summarization (ADR-0004: calendar data never leaves the machine). host.docker.internal:11434 is the settled address for Ollama from inside n8n — it requires the host's Ollama to listen on a container-reachable interface (OLLAMA_HOST), not only 127.0.0.1. onError: continueRegularOutput means a down/slow Ollama flows an error item to Finalize Reply, which falls back to the deterministic rundown instead of failing the webhook. BUG-001: the 30s timeout here was below the 31-48s this prompt actually needs on this host, so every day with events fell back silently; it is now 50s, still well inside the gateway's 60s agenda dispatch budget (FEAT-004) plus the ~0.4s Calendar fetch. The node timeout must never approach that budget: if it did, the gateway would abort first and the user would lose even the fallback.
